Need to search first.I don't have any research notes on Psalm 141 for you. None of the sources were retrieved, so I can't give you the verse-by-verse notes yet.

My first attempt to fetch the commentary pages was rejected: the fetch tool only opens addresses that have first come up in a search. My batch of searches then didn't run because I had used up my research tool calls for this turn. I didn't read any page on enduringword.com, biblehub.com, preceptaustin.org, netbible.org or the other approved sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Writing notes from memory would break both, so I've left the notes out.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll do the research properly:
1. **Search the approved sites** for Psalm 141, both the whole chapter and key verses (v. 2 incense and evening offering, v. 3 guarding the mouth, v. 5 the righteous man's rebuke, vv. 6–7, the hardest verses).
2. **Read the pages the searches return:**
   - Enduring Word
   - Bible Hub verse pages (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit)
   - Precept Austin and Spurgeon's *Treasury of David*
   - NET Bible notes
   - Orthodox and Catholic material on this psalm's use in evening prayer
   - anything from the different Protestant traditions that touches this psalm
3. **Write the notes as "v. 1: …" through "v. 10: …"**, with each point followed by its URL. Anything I can't find in the sources will be left out.
